_comment: Modular character catalog for Penzilla Ultimate Protagonist (CustomaizableCharacter). Contains only names, palettes and rules - no image data. Tints are Penzilla's own colour variants measured as multipliers of the white Blank layers (see docs/CHARACTER_SYSTEM.md). Layer files are generated by tools/assets/import_character.py.

shoes_black._note: Penzilla names the black shoes 'Blank' in Idle/Interact/IdleHoldingTool (verified by colour).

clips._comment: Animation clips built from the Penzilla frames (own sequences, face changes, head/body offsets in source pixels, event markers). Same style as the pack because every pixel is original Penzilla art. Used by players and NPCs alike (CharacterRig.play).

activity_clips._comment: What NPCs do while an activity is shown (weights). Data only – extend freely.
